facts.text: Serve the mains when Holden and Banky argue it out in the diner booth.
facts.why: The diner scene in the film is Holden meeting Jay and Silent Bob for lunch, where he hands over their residual pay and Bob tells the Amy story. Holden and Banky's fights happen in their studio and when Holden invites them over, not in a diner booth.
facts.fix: Serve the mains when Holden sits down with Jay and Silent Bob at the diner.

facts.text: The diner booth where the friendship gets tested.
facts.why: Same mix up as the cue. The diner booth is where Holden talks to Jay and Silent Bob and hears Bob's Amy story. The friendship with Banky is tested elsewhere.
facts.fix: The diner booth where Silent Bob tells his Amy story.

facts.text: I'm not great with words, Alyssa, so I ordered enough pizza to say it for me. Grab a slice.
facts.why: Set out as Holden's words under 'From the booth'. He never says it and no pizza scene like this appears in the plot. His real confession is the long 'I love you... I love you. And not in a friendly way' speech, and he also says 'Sorry about him, he's dealing with being an inker.'
facts.fix: Pull up a seat and eat. Sorry about Banky, he's dealing with being an inker.

fix_note.text: Pull up a seat and eat. Sorry about Banky, he's dealing with being an inker.

facts.why: Wikipedia names the duo's shared studio in Red Bank as Bank-Hold-Up. Bluntman is the comic, not the studio.

facts.text: Holden's order, while he plans the Chasing Amy comic.
facts.why: No source shows what Holden orders. Wikipedia does have him ending up writing the Chasing Amy comic, so the line says that instead.
facts.fix: One for Holden, who ends up writing the Chasing Amy comic.

vibe.verdict: Bluntman and Chronic, the birds pudding and the inker line give it some bite, but the dark neon board feels more arcade than Jersey diner.
